## Context
The generated configuration reference enumerates key, type, default, and lifecycle data from typed dataclass fields but provides no public setting descriptions. It cannot serve as the external settings contract until each emitted key explains its user-visible effect.

## Plan
- Add concise `public_description` metadata to every dataclass field emitted through `_SECTION_CLASSES`.
- Preserve field types, defaults, factories, coercion, and runtime behavior.
- Extend `scripts/gen_config_reference.py` to require nonempty description metadata and render a Description column.
- Fail generation when an emitted field lacks a description.
- Regenerate `docs/config-reference.md`.
- Add focused completeness, escaping, and drift tests.
- Keep `src/rebar` modules below the absolute 800-line limit. Use an existing configuration-section seam if an extraction is required.

## Testing
- `python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check`
- `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py tests/unit/test_config_typed.py tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py -q`
- `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check && test $(wc -l < src/rebar/_config_schema.py) -le $(cat .github/module-size-limit.txt)`
- `make lint && make typecheck`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every generated typed key has one nonempty public description.
- [ ] The generator fails with the missing key named when metadata is absent.
- [ ] Descriptions state user-visible behavior without duplicating type, default, or lifecycle columns.
- [ ] Generated Markdown escapes table-sensitive content correctly.
- [ ] Typed field types, defaults, factories, and coercion remain unchanged.
- [ ] Configuration runtime behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] `_config_schema.py` remains within the absolute module-size limit.
- [ ] The focused generator and configuration tests pass.
- [ ] Lint and type checks pass.
